steps.text: While that is running, listen to this thought. I have been considering how to organise my desk. I want to keep my notebooks together and leave room for a lamp. Let me finish describing the idea before you answer.

adaptive.agenda: Ask Jarvis to create a task to write a Hello World page, without requesting notification. Then discuss how to arrange a desk. Let the conversation develop naturally.
Ask Jarvis to create a task to write a Hello World page and explicitly ask to be told when it finishes. Then wait patiently. Do not ask for its status or remind Jarvis about the task.
Ask Jarvis to create a task to write a Hello World page and notify you. Immediately change your mind and clearly ask it to stay quiet when the task completes. Discuss a desk lamp afterwards.
Ask for a Hello World page task without an announcement, then immediately clearly request notification when it finishes. Wait patiently afterwards without asking its status.
Ask for a Hello World page task and notification. If Jarvis starts a long reply, interrupt naturally to ask it to be brief. Then give it room to continue. Do not ask whether the task has finished.
Ask for a nonurgent Hello World page task. Talk about planning a relaxing afternoon. Allow natural pauses, and do not ask for task status.
